RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 10

That number is a tentative subjective judgment, not a statistically grounded estimate. An all-male panel raises a reasonable question about panel diversity, but does not itself show sex influenced this appointment. You and the successful candidate are both men; nothing you describe establishes sex discrimination.

Your longer experience merits asking how it was weighed, although relevant digital expertise could legitimately outweigh tenure.

Follow up now on your written request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, your assessment, and any policy governing panel composition. Raise the panel’s composition as a procedural question, not an accusation. Check applicable complaint deadlines promptly; these depend on the jurisdiction and broadcaster.
